component.name: Kerf
component.summary: Precise audio editor for turning live recordings into albums

description.p: Kerf is a fast, precise, non-destructive audio editor. It finds where the songs in a concert recording start, names them from a setlist, levels the whole show, tags the tracks and exports FLAC, WAV or a CD image with a CUE sheet.
Edits are sample-exact and undoable without limit. A command-line tool and an MCP server let scripts and AI assistants do the same work, including on the project open in the app.
